messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: citations for using Stan?
parts:
If you have papers that have used Stan, we'd love to hear
about it. We finally got some submissions, so we're going
to start a list on the web site for 2.0 in earnest. You can
either mail them to the list, to me directly, or just update
the issue (at least until it's closed or moved):

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/187

I think I'm going to have to back off thanking everyone who's
given us help in the manual. We just lost track with all of the t
raffic we've been getting, so rather than risk missing people,
I'm just going to rewrite the introductory acknowledgments to generically
point to GitHub and the users and dev lists.

- Bob
